offerings.name: Reader API (s.jina.ai / SERP)
offerings.pricing: 按 token 计费 — "Every request costs a fixed number of tokens, starting from 10,000 tokens"; 标准 key "$50 / 0.050 / 1M tokens"（1B tokens），Premium key "$500 / 0.045 / 1M tokens"（11B tokens）
offerings.price_basis: Standard key（$0.050/1M tokens，每次搜索固定消耗 10,000 tokens → $0.0005/次）
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens (Toy Experiment, 10 Million tokens, non-commercial use only, CC-BY-NC)
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果（LLM-friendly text block：top 5 结果，各含 URL、title、content）
offerings.note: 返回 top five results with their URLs and contents；平均延迟 2.5s；限速 100 RPM（w/o 或 free key）、1000 RPM（premium key）；定价基于 token usage，API pricing is based on the token usage；2025-05-06 新定价模型。
